# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Logo: Jobber's official mark, provided by Jobber.
- Added the `jobber` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.getjobber.com/mcp`.
- Declared `CLIENT_ID` and `CLIENT_SECRET` plugin variables and forwarded them through MCP auth, since Jobber requires manual OAuth client registration.
